title: SmartSleep Plus
description: Smart percent sleep with AFK filtering, night and storm skip, progress UI.
body:
# SmartSleep Plus

Overview
SmartSleep Plus skips night based on a configurable sleep percent, with AFK-aware player counting and clean progress feedback.

Highlights
- Percent-based sleep skip with per-world checks.
- AFK exclusion so inactive players do not block sleep.
- Optional storm clearing and action bar progress display.
- Per-player opt-out toggle with /smartsleep on|off.

Commands
- /smartsleep [status|on|off|reload]

Permissions
- smartsleepplus.use

Config
- required-percent, min-players, ignore-afk, afk-seconds
- skip-night, skip-storm, show-progress

Tags
sleep, one-player-sleep, night-skip, storm-skip, afk, qol, utility

Compatibility
Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
Game versions: 1.16.5 - 1.21.1
